question.text: A radio-active material is reduced to $1 / 8$ of its original amount in 3 days. If $8 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{~kg}$ of the material is left after 5 days. The initial amount of the material is

solution.text:
$\mathrm{N}=\mathrm{N}_0\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\mathrm{n}}$
$\mathrm{N}=\frac{\mathrm{N}_0}{8}$
$\frac{\mathrm{N}_0}{8}=\mathrm{N}_0\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\mathrm{n}} \Rightarrow\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^3=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\mathrm{n}}$
$\mathrm{n}=3$
3 half lives $=3$ days
1 half life $=1$ day
5 days $=5$ half life
$\mathrm{N}=\mathrm{N}_0\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\mathrm{n}} \Rightarrow 8 \times 10^{-3}=\mathrm{N}_0\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^5$
$\Rightarrow \quad N_0=2^5 \times 8 \times 10^{-3}=256 \mathrm{gm}$
